summary: Image storage migration & 5-image stock master + Stock Summary Export — backend (13 pytest) and frontend (Playwright) end-to-end testing complete. All scenarios pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line ~1107 — invalid content_type returns 400 ('Unsupported image type: ...'). The review_request mentioned 415 as acceptable. Current 400 is consistent with empty-file/oversize handling. Acceptable but consider using 415 specifically for unsupported media types per HTTP semantics.

server.py /api/files/{path:path} — GET via query-param token (?auth=) bypasses HttpOnly-cookie protections that tags can't carry. Token in URL may end up in browser history / referrer headers. Acceptable trade-off but consider short-lived signed URLs for hardening.

stock-balance only emits rows for items with positive transactions; items created via Stock Master that have NO IN transaction won't appear in /balance regardless of their `images` array. Verified by direct test — schema includes `images: []` field but newly-created items aren't surfaced. Document this behaviour for users who upload images then expect to see them in Stock Summary.

StockMasterImageUploader — when 5 slots are full, the dropzone + 'Choose files' (form-images-pick) still allow re-triggering the file input; uploader correctly toasts 'You can upload a maximum of 5 images. 0 slot(s) left.' Consider disabling the pick button visually when full for clearer UX.
AuthImage component fetches each image as a blob via axios — for tables with many images this means N parallel requests with no caching. Consider cache or service-worker for thumbnails.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ stock-master item via UI (PT_TEST_54F1 / TESTMAKE) with 4 images. Backend pytest creates+deletes its own TEST_IMG_* items per test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest fixtures: fixtures `token`, `auth_headers`, `uploaded_path` (module-scoped). Stock Master required fields: part_no + make (NOT item_code as primary key — that's optional). Form testid uses dashes: `form-part-no` (NOT `form-part_no`). 5-slot uploader testids: form-images-{dropzone,input,pick,empty-N,thumb-N,slot-N,view-N,remove-N}. ImageViewerDialog testids: image-viewer-{dialog,close,prev,next,label}. The prev/next arrows are HIDDEN (count=0), not just disabled, on first/last image respectively. Stock Master table image cell testid: image-cell-{id} (clickable container) and image-thumb-{id} (the AuthImage), with image-count-{id} badge for items with >1 image. Stock Balance table image cell: balance-image-{rowIdx}. balance-export-button downloads xlsx via blob; filename pattern Stock_Summary_YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx. Verified file size shrinks when search filter applied (34080 → 21741 bytes for BELT filter, 7 rows).
